available_amount.description: Funds available for spend in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents for USD)

created.description: Date and time for when the balance was first created.

currency.description: 3-character alphabetic ISO 4217 code for the local currency of the balance.

token.description: Globally unique identifier for the financial account that holds this balance.

last_transaction_event_token.description: Globally unique identifier for the last financial transaction event that impacted this balance.

last_transaction_token.description: Globally unique identifier for the last financial transaction that impacted this balance.

pending_amount.description: Funds not available for spend due to card authorizations or pending ACH release. Shown in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents for USD).

total_amount.description: The sum of available and pending balance in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents for USD).

updated.description: Date and time for when the balance was last updated.
